**Rules and compatibility.**

- **Paid choice and recharge:** shared preview and command select one eligible cell, diver before controlled hold with stable item identity, and debit exactly 25 for the existing 12-second pulse. No fractional pooling or remote payment. An independent matrix varied two cells across six charge levels and six location compositions on an earned warning/piloting state: 216 compositions, 144 paid successes, 72 atomic no-charge refusals, 144 atomic active-repeat refusals and two exact outward-boundary refusals. Whole-state comparisons preserved all unrelated fields; refused `stepGame` commands were compared with ordinary no-input advancement. Current source/tests additionally cover the service-tool prerequisite and carried use. Pre-vehicle recharge independently changed only eligible local cell charges and feedback. Hull service, reserve-to-hull power and healthy empty-battery recovery remain separate; quiet/cover/retreat require no charge.
- **Local sources and storage:** the shared site helper preserves physical support predicates and distinguishes the actual bench/cradle. Fabrication, preview and transfer eligibility agree on diver, this site's restored locker, local deployed buoy and supported local cargo. Remote/other-site/berth/transaction access and locked workshop self-funding remain excluded. Source/tests cover disabled local cargo, ordinary controlled access, all eight material kinds, capacity/empty/equipment exclusions and overflow atomicity. My independent bulk probe conserved whole stack IDs, quantities and provenance across the entire state and proved repeat/other-site refusal atomicity. Explicit operands and individual transfers remain available.
- **Useful return refit:** registry, commands and strict relationships implement one retained 2 CU `dart_acoustic_trim`, costing exactly two crust and two resin after C04 plus Dart receipt. A diagnostic command fork of an immutable historical earned export independently created `item_22` from its existing cargo, installed/removed/transferred it and retained its exact identity through incapacity. Installation uses one of two sockets and cargo capacity; removal leaves the same item in that hold, and installed transfer refuses. Source and meaningful current tests cover full-hold installation, occupancy/locality/transaction refusals, disabled-collar access, service/repair/berth preservation and swept tow→remove→transfer→salvage→rebuild→reinstall. Frame investment and rescue allocation stay distinct from reusable trim. Receipt/item cardinality prevents duplication/deletion.
- **Performance:** only a valid installed trim changes controlled Dart quiet target 3→4.2 and boost 11→9 m/s; normal 8 remains. Source/tests preserve input precedence, acceleration, collision/depth, loudness and per-second drain. This is a real travel tradeoff, without normal-cruise silence, pressure benefit or new threat immunity.
- **Compatibility and journal policy:** writes are schema2/content `expedition.3`; validated foundation.1 and expedition.2 remain explicit read paths. The old-domain guard rejects new item/receipt/module data disguised as `.2`, before shared strict validation. Six independent invalid relationship mutations failed current encode and both decoder tags; valid new-domain data retagged `.2` also failed. Current tests cover the wider reference/type/owner/capacity set, foundation initialization and checked carrier placement/current-encode refusal. Import over a different expedition and reconstructed reopen/Continue preserved exact pre-import `previous`, unchanged `preserved` and original input bytes. These session probes used injected memory storage/lock ports, not a fresh native browser-lock test.
